services.desc: Stay productive with the help of Best Western PREMIER Boulder Falls Inn, a hotel and conference center offering a spacious and convenient location perfect for meetings and events in the Willamette Valley. Choose from intimate event space overlooking our tranquil Japanese garden or take advantage of the 12,000-square-foot conference center located next door. Whether you're in town for business or a celebration, Boulder Falls Inn provides a memorable and convenient location for your next event.
